notes.title: New update includes teleporting
notes.content: You asked for it, so here it is. Not much has changed as far as content, but a few behind the scenes fixes and players can now teleport around the room by using the trigger. It's perfect for those with confined playspaces or that just are feeling lazy.

notes.title: New Rooms
notes.content:
To celebrate releasing our newest game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/648380/Bullet_Dodge/]Bullet Dodge[/url], we have added two new rooms to Escape the Gray. 
Also, a few shadows were updated in this version.
